report:
Ear, left cholesteatoma, resection

Received in formalin are fragments of white keratinous material labelled left cholesteatoma, measuring 0.8 x 0.5 x 0.2 cm in aggregate. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Keratinous material, all embedded.

Sections show lamellated keratinous debris. No intact squamous epithelium is identified. Features are consistent with cholesteatoma. There is no evidence of malignancy.

EAR, left cholesteatoma, resection - Consistent with CHOLESTEATOMA
